default_zone.description: The initial zone assigned to interfaces with no explicit zone binding (e.g., 'public', 'internal', 'trusted').

log_denied.description: Whether to log packets that are dropped or rejected. Valid values: 'off', 'unicast', 'broadcast', 'multicast', 'all'.

backend.description: Firewall backend. Use 'nftables' for modern kernels; 'iptables' for legacy.

reload_policy.description: Policy during reload. Can be 'DROP', 'REJECT', 'ACCEPT' or per-table like 'OUTPUT:ACCEPT,INPUT:DROP,FORWARD:REJECT'.
